_note: STUB (grading T-04): 11 representative questions only. The full 100-question key is built in T-07. Transcribed from the official USCIS list; question numbers follow the order of that list. Accepted answers are stored already normalised (lowercase, no punctuation, hyphens as spaces); numeral variants are listed explicitly; optional words are stored as both variants. Dynamic questions (answers change with elections, appointments or where the user lives) carry no accepted answers.
